explication: Lithe is a lightweight, cross-platform IDE focused on Java and Spring Boot, with workflows for understanding, editing, running, debugging, and reviewing projects. The user opens a project, works in the editor with navigation and search, then runs or debugs code and reviews changes. The macOS app separates application features from language-intelligence and Rust core services; platform-specific storage and plugin support round out the product. README-documented capabilities are included, while unsampled subsystem links are limited to documented relationships.
